items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And they also had the Trenier Twins upstairs during this period.

ctx.x: Right. It was just a gimmick for being able to stay open as long as you were greasing the right palms.

And right up the street from there was the Cafe Society, and they had a band downstairs and upstairs. They had a little trio, a very fine trio playing in there. And they also had the Trenier Twins upstairs during this period.
